entries.title: Psalms 141:1
segments: A Psalm of David. O LORD, I cry to You; make haste to me, give ear to my voice when I cry to You.

entries.title: Psalms 141:2
segments: Let my prayer be set forth before You [as] incense, [and] the lifting up of my hands [as] the evening sacrifice.

entries.title: Psalms 141:3
segments: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 141:4
segments: Let not my heart turn aside to [any] evil thing, to practice wicked works with men who work iniquity; and let me not eat of their delicacies.

entries.title: Psalms 141:5
segments: Let the righteous strike me; [it shall be] a kindness; and let him correct me, [it is] oil on my head, let not my head refuse [it]; for still my prayer also [shall be] against their wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 141:6
segments: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

entries.title: Psalms 141:7
segments: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cuts and splits [wood] on the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 141:8
segments: But my eyes [are] on You, O Lord Jehovah; in You I take refuge, do not leave my soul naked.

entries.title: Psalms 141:9
segments: Keep me from the traps which they have laid for me, and the snares of the workers of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 141:10
segments: Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I escape.
